product_metadata.title: OJOJ 20oz Travel Mug with Handle Insulated Tumbler with Leak Proof Lid, Stainless Steel Coffee Mug for Cold and Hot Beverages, Blue

Keep Hot and Cold - The insulated tumbler uses double wall vacuum insulation technology, keep hot for 6 hours and keep cold 12 hours.
Perfect for All Occasions - This wildly popular bottle can be used at home, work and the gym, perfect for car beverage holder.
